job.title: Payroll Specialist
job.description:
Payroll Specialist

A fantastic opportunity for an experienced Payroll Specialist or Senior Payroll Officer to join a growing organisation in a pivotal payroll position. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys owning the end-to-end payroll function, driving process improvements, and partnering with the wider finance team to ensure payroll accuracy, compliance, and efficiency.

We are open to considering experienced End-to-End Payroll Officers looking to take the next step in their career, as well as Payroll Supervisors seeking a more hands-on payroll role without direct reports.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the end-to-end payroll process, ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.
  • Process new starters, terminations, leave calculations, allowances, deductions, and payroll adjustments.
  • Ensure accurate calculation and processing of superannuation, payroll tax, PAYG, and other statutory obligations.
  • Maintain compliance with relevant legislation, awards, enterprise agreements, and company policies.
  • Prepare and reconcile payroll reports, month-end journals, and payroll-related balance sheet accounts.
  • Manage Single Touch Payroll (STP) reporting and other statutory lodgements.
  • Respond to payroll queries and provide exceptional support to employees and stakeholders.
  • Conduct regular payroll audits and reconciliations to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Maintain employee payroll records and ensure data integrity within payroll systems.
  • Identify and implement payroll process improvements to enhance efficiency and reduce risk.
  • Assist with payroll system upgrades, testing, and implementation of new processes.
  • Work collaboratively with HR and Finance teams to support payroll and business requirements.

Skills & Experience

  • Demonstrated experience processing end-to-end payroll within an Australian environment.
  • Strong understanding of Australian payroll legislation, awards, and compliance requirements.
  • Experience with STP, superannuation, payroll tax, and statutory reporting.
  • High attention to detail with strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to build relationships across the business.
  • Strong systems aptitude and proficiency in Microsoft Excel.
  • Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Commitment to confidentiality and handling sensitive information with discretion.

Desirable

  • Exposure to high-volume or multi-site payroll environments.
  • Relevant payroll, finance, accounting, or business qualifications.

If you're ready to step into a new role e and bring your payroll expertise to a business at values hard work and collaboration, we’d love to hear from you.

Please ‘Apply now’ or send through your resume to alisha.massey@huntermanning.com

job.title: Accounts Payable Officer
job.description:
Hunter Manning is looking for an experienced Accounts Payable Officer to join our clients finance team on a 12-month parental leave contract which could lead to a permanent opportunity. This is a great chance to step into a supportive, well-established team where you will support the smooth running of the AP function.

You will be working with an exceptional business who has a fantastic work culture and values every contribution of each employee.

What you'll be doing

  • Processing high volumes of supplier invoices accurately and on time
  • Matching invoices to purchase orders and receipts, and resolving discrepancies
  • Preparing and processing weekly and monthly payment runs
  • Reconciling supplier statements and following up on outstanding queries
  • Maintaining supplier master data and ensuring vendor details are verified and secure
  • Processing employee expense claims and corporate credit card reconciliations
  • Responding to supplier and internal enquiries professionally and promptly
  • Assisting with month-end close, accruals and reporting
  • Supporting compliance with internal controls, GST requirements and company policies

About you

  • At least 2 years' experience in a similar accounts payable role
  • Strong working knowledge of large ERP system
  • Intermediate Excel skills (VLOOKUPs, pivot tables)
  • Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to your work
  • Strong communication skills and a customer-focused attitude
  • Ability to manage competing deadlines in a busy environment
  • Full Australian working rights and based in Perth

job.title: Assistant Accountant
job.description:

  • Clear, friendly communication skills
  • The ability to work independently and manage your own deadlines
  • Availability to start immediately or at short notice
  • Full Australian working rights and based in Perth

We look forward to your application!

job.title: FP&A Manager
job.description:
About the business
Our client is an ASX Perth head officed mining services provider based in East Perth with a strong National and International customer base. The business is seeking an FP&A Manager to join its finance function.

About the role

Reporting to the CFO, you'll turn operational activity into short-term and multi-year financial plans and give the business the insight it needs to make sound decisions. This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll work with senior management, operational leaders and the broader finance team.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Leading the annual budgeting process and preparing budget packs and commentary for senior management and the Board
  • Maintaining a rolling forecast, with variance analysis and clear commentary
  • Developing scenario and sensitivity models to support strategic and commercial decisions
  • Owning the standard cost framework and unit economics, including return on capital analysis
  • Producing monthly performance and cost analysis, identifying key drivers, risks and opportunities
  • Owning and improving the business's financial models and planning tools, including identifying opportunities to automate and streamline processes
  • Maintaining the integrity of planning and forecasting data in partnership with IT and operations
  • Contributing to monthly management and Board reporting
  • Leading, guiding and reviewing the work of a commercial analyst

About you

  • CPA or CA qualified
  • Solid experience in FP&A, management accounting or commercial finance
  • Advanced Excel skills and the ability to build financial models from scratch
  • Strong understanding of standard costing and variance analysis
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to present financial information to non-finance audiences
  • Collaborative, solutions-focused and able to manage competing priorities
  • Team leadership experience and experience in asset-intensive industries will be highly regarded

job.title: Commercial Analyst
job.description:
About the business

Our client is a privately owned, Perth head officed mining equipment provider based in the Perth Airport precinct, servicing customers across WA and beyond. With a commercially focused leadership team, the business is seeking a Commercial Finance Analyst to play a key role in its commercial decision-making.

About the role
Reporting into the finance leadership team, you'll provide commercial analysis that supports profitable growth. This is a varied, hands-on role where you'll partner closely with sales, operations and senior management.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Developing, maintaining and reviewing pricing across the business's products and services
  • Preparing financial models and pricing recommendations for management
  • Supporting tenders and proposals with commercial analysis
  • Analysing customer, product and revenue performance to identify opportunities for improvement
  • Producing regular commercial and performance reporting with insightful commentary
  • Monitoring market and competitor trends to inform commercial decisions
  • Partnering with sales and operational teams to provide commercial insight and decision support

About you

  • CPA, CA or CFA qualified (or well progressed) – highly regarded
  • Tertiary qualifications in Finance, Commerce, Economics or a related discipline
  • Solid experience in commercial finance, pricing or business analysis
  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling skills
  • Strong analytical ability, with a talent for turning data into clear commercial action
  • Excellent communication skills and the confidence to engage with stakeholders at all levels
  • A commercially minded approach and the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment

job.title: Accounts Officer

job.title: Senior Finance Business Partner
job.description:
A well-established, privately owned manufacturing and services business is seeking a Senior Finance Business Partner to be the finance "go-to" for their WA operation.

This is a genuinely standalone, business-facing role. You'll work hands-on with Operations, Sales and Contractors day to day — not just producing month-end reporting. The business wants a finance partner who understands the commercial and operational side of the business, not someone content to sit behind a desk removed from it.

The role:

  • Act as the primary finance contact for the WA site, partnering closely with the General Manager, Operations, Sales and Contractors
  • Full end-to-end management accounting, including project and labour recovery accounting
  • Balance sheet reconciliations, month-end reporting and process improvement
  • Confidently challenge and support operational decision-making — commercial backbone and credibility with senior stakeholders is essential
  • Genuine day-to-day autonomy in the role

About you:

  • CA/CPA qualified with 5+ years' post-qualification experience
  • Background in manufacturing, industrial, contracting or project-based environments highly regarded
  • Confident operating standalone and building strong relationships with non-finance stakeholders
  • Experience with major ERP systems (SAP, Pronto, D365 or similar) an advantage
  • Comfortable pushing back when required, and equally comfortable building trust with senior operational leaders

On offer:

  • $140,000–$160,000 + Super, dependent on experience
  • On-site role with flexibility around hours by arrangement
  • Genuine autonomy and a seat close to the business
  • Strong internal culture with investment in staff development
  • Will move quickly for the right person, but happy to wait to find them
